messages:
Aisha Khan: hey team - quick Q: I just got married in India last week and my spouse doesn't have a US SSN. I'm US-based and want to add them to health/dental midyear. What docs do I need and what's the effective date? :tada:
Samir Patel: congrats!! :tada: this qualifies as a QLE (marriage). please submit within 30 days of the event. core docs we need below — you can upload to the benefits portal. effective date is generally the date of the QLE (date of marriage) if you provide docs, but payroll/back-pay has cutoffs.
Jules Nguyen: short checklist for benefits upload (copy + scan ok):
```
- certified marriage certificate (if not in English: certified translation)
- spouse photo ID (passport)
- proof of shared US address (utility, lease, or joint bank statement) OR spouse's US entry stamp + US address proof
- if spouse has NO SSN: signed "No SSN Affidavit" (we have template) + passport copy
```
Aisha Khan: thanks — spouse is still in India and will join me in 6 weeks. we don't have a shared US address yet. does that change anything?
Samir Patel: fine — you can still add them now under marriage QLE. for proof of address, submit an affidavit stating expected US move date + copies of flight/visa OR use your own proof of residence and note spouse's foreign address. we'll accept a temporary exception while they are abroad.
Jules Nguyen: note on payroll/taxes: if spouse doesn't have an SSN or ITIN, payroll can't add them as a tax dependent for withholding purposes. you can still enroll them in benefits; payroll will set deductions normally but you may need to file for ITIN later. if you want payroll to attempt retroactive premium deduction adjustment, include a note when you upload docs.
Tara Lopez: FYI benefits team — please expedite review if docs show marriage date <= 30 days. cc @Jules.
Payroll Bot: created case PR-9876 for Aisha Khan — pending docs. Payroll cut-off for next pay cycle: 2024-12-01 17:00 PST. Retro adj requests subject to payroll approvals.
Aisha Khan: great, I'll upload the marriage cert + passport + my lease and the no-ssn affidavit. how do I get the affidavit template?
Samir Patel: here's the link to upload + templates: https://benefits.redwoodinference.com/qle/upload (use "marriage - international spouse" category). Affidavit template: https://benefits.redwoodinference.com/docs/no-ssn-affidavit.pdf
Jules Nguyen: if you want coverage effective back to the marriage date, add "retro request" in the upload form and include bank/credit card proof of premium payments if applicable. typical backdate window is up to 60 days but subject to approvals.
Aisha Khan: perfect — uploading now. thanks all!
Samir Patel: once we accept docs we'll confirm effective date and whether payroll needs a retro adj. expect a confirmation message here within 1-2 business days. :+1:
Aisha Khan: thanks — appreciate the quick help!
